summary: Företag 23 develops, produces and sells oat-based food and beverage products, including oat drinks, yogurt alternatives, spreads and frozen desserts. The company is one of the world's best-known plant-based dairy alternative brands.
target_market: Global plant-based food and beverage market
strategy_notes: Focused on expanding global distribution of oat-based products through retail and foodservice channels while strengthening brand awareness and sustainable food positioning.
technology_notes: Commercializes proprietary oat-processing expertise and product formulations for dairy alternative food and beverage products.
risk_notes: Subject to competitive pressure in the plant-based category, commodity price volatility, changing consumer preferences, supply chain challenges and profitability improvement requirements.
